title: Generic canonical tensor-route calculation and ordinary pullback braiding
statement: For additive exact strong monoidal flat-preserving F between the monoidal Grothendieck abelian categories with functorial flat resolutions, assuming ordinary braiding compatibility, the canonical counit-normalized derived tensor presentation computes the explicit tensorModelMap for every homotopy complex, without flatness of the fixed coefficient or of that complex. Ordinary inverse image of the internal modules has the required braiding compatibility. The precise hypotheses are the two attached Lean signatures.

source.place: Lemma 6.5.9(3), Remark 6.8.15; canonical tensor counit and balanced tensor presentations

proof.text: Normalize the canonical tensor presentation using the left-derived counit identities. Move the single coefficient comparison by naturality; apply the derived tensor-comparison counit equation. Use homotopy braiding compatibility, cancel inverse braidings, and apply exact-functor counit naturality. Ordinary pullback braiding is checked on balanced tensor epimorphisms and transported along the coefficient isomorphism.

lean.statement:
theorem residueTensorRoute_generic (F : C ⥤ D) [F.Additive]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits F] [PreservesFiniteColimits F] [F.IsLeftAdjoint]
    [F.Monoidal] [F.PreservesFlat]
    (hF : ∀ K L : C, F.map (β_ K L).hom ≫ Functor.OplaxMonoidal.δ F L K =
      Functor.OplaxMonoidal.δ F K L ≫ (β_ (F.obj K) (F.obj L)).hom)
    (B : C) (H : DerivedCategory C ⥤ DerivedCategory C)
    (ε : DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ H ⟶
      (tensorLeft B).mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh)
    [H.IsLeftDerivedFunctor ε (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso C (.up ℤ))]
    (P : HomotopyCategory C (.up ℤ)) :
    F.leftDerivedFunctor.map
        ((derivedTensorPresentationIso B H ε).hom.app (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj P)) ≫
      (F.leftDerivedTensorComparison.app (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj P)).app
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor C 0).obj B) ≫
      Functor.tensorModelTarget F B P = Functor.tensorModelMap F B H ε P
